That's why all those Yalbec males tried to eat us.''"
"''Uh, technically they were trying to mate with us.|Hunter and Tech recount Clone Force 99's encounter with the Yalbecs|}} '''Yalbec''' were an [[insectoid]] [[species]] found on [[Yalbec Prime]]. During the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], several Yalbec were involved in an [[Insurrection on Yalbec Prime]], during which they came into conflict with the Republic's elite [[Clone Force 99]]. ==Biology and appearance== {{Quote|And for your information, the stinger of a Yalbec queen is a delicacy on some planets.|Tech informs his fellow clones of trivia on a Yalbec queen's stinger|}} Yalbec biology included at least two [[Gender|sexes]], male and female. Some females were classified as [[queen]]s and possessed [[Yalbec queen stinger|stingers]]. Male members of the species could only be [[Death|killed]] with bladed weapons and in some cases would attempt to mate with nearby organisms if a queen's stinger was cut off. The stingers of Yalbec queens were considered delicacies on several worlds. ==History== {{Quote|Ever fought a male Yalbec?''"
"''Um, no, can't say that I have.''"
"''You're lucky. Only way to kill 'em is with one of these.|Wrecker and Jesse before the former tells the latter that Yalbec males can only be killed with a blade |}} [[File:Wrecker_Anaxes.png|thumb|right|200px|Wrecker, a clone commando who cut off a Yalbec queen's stinger]] During the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], an [[Insurrection on Yalbec Prime|insurrection]] occurred on [[Yalbec Prime]], prompting the Republic to send an elite group of [[clone trooper]]s known as [[Clone Force 99]] to deal with it. The [[Cloning|clones]] came into conflict with a group of Yalbec while trying to put down the insurrection, and the clone known as [[Wrecker]] chopped off the stinger of a [[Unidentified Yalbec queen|Yalbec queen]] while she was still alive. This triggered several Yalbec males to try and mate with the clones, which the clone [[Hunter]] mistook for an attempt to eat them. Fighting the Yalbec delayed the clones in traveling to the [[planet]] [[Anaxes]] for their next [[Battle of Anaxes|mission]]. Once they reached the world, Hunter and Wrecker recounted their fight against the Yalbec to the clones [[Cody]], [[Jesse]], [[Kix]] and [[Rex]], and during the story another Clone Force 99 member known as [[Tech]] corrected Hunter saying that the male Yalbecs were attempting to mate with them instead of trying to eat them. ==Behind the scenes== The Yalbec were first mentioned in "[[The Bad Batch (episode)|The Bad Batch]]," an episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The episode was written to be the premiere of the show's seventh season, but ''The Clone Wars'' was cancelled before it was made and released. The unfinished story reels of the episodes were then shown at [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]] in [[2015]], before being released on [[StarWars.com]] later that year as part of ''[[The Clone Wars Legacy]]''. A finalized version of the episode did debut as part of the show's eventual [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh]] and final season in [[2020]]. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{TCW|The Bad Batch (episode)}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Yalbec |ja=ヤルベク |pl=Yalbecowie }} [[Category:Insects]] [[Category:Species of undefined sentience]]
